The creatures they also roll and that are not listed (the Tusker Slave 1628, the Tusker Worshippers 22515 and 22516, the White Phyntos Wasp 7105, the Tuskie Launcher 22522 and Thrower 22523, and the Mid mixes' Tusker Liberator 22519, Redeemer 22520, Horned Chittick 4243, Jungle Reaver 22745, Tusker Minions 22511 and 22512 and Jungle Phyntos Wasp 7183) are not judged by the approach check and, met, give the retreat line the general fallback; the cost counts them at the listed kinds' mean. No landblock_instance row of these landblocks places a creature (the Barracks' portal 0x7F07F000 and the Armory's 0x7EF7F000 only).
